name: new-indie-friday
description: New Indie Friday (NIF) root — launches the frontend and Sanity studio together.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,studio,open -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix studio run dev" "npm run open-browser"
scripts.open-browser: node -e "setTimeout(() => { const { exec } = require('child_process'); exec('start http://localhost:5173/'); exec('start http://localhost:3333/'); }, 4000)"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix studio install
